sentences.text: Criminal Case No. 108 of 2020 arising out of FIR vide Crime No.581 of 2019 registered at Police Station Aron, District Guna for offence punishable under Sections 379 and 382 of IPC.

Facts giving rise to present petition in short are that o n 22-07-2019, at around 19:22 petitioner No.1 Smt. Neelu Kushwah, wife of Rajeev Kushwah, lodged an FIR vide Crime No.383 of 2019 at Police Station Aron, District Guna against one Arvind Shrivastava and Shivkumar Raghunshi, who are both advocates in profession regarding commission of kidnapping and rape under Sections 366,
376, 506, 385, 511 of IPC.
After completion of investigation and other formalities, charge sheet has been filed by police in that matter.

Later on, petitioner No.1 Smt. Neelu Kushwah, wife of Rajeev Kushwah, (herein petitioner No.2) also lodged an FIR vide Crime No. 580 of 2019 at same police station on 16-11-2019 at around 19:12 against advocate Arvind Shrivastava and two unknown persons for offence punishable under Sections 323, 294, 506, 34 of IPC in which it is alleged by the petitioner No.1 Smt. Neelu Kushwah that during commission of marpeet, the mobile of Arvind Shrivastava Airtel SIM number of which is 9893745090 was dropped at the place of incident and aforesaid mobile was handed over to police on the same day i.e. 16-11-2019 at about 06:55 pm.

On the same day, friend of Arvind Shrivastava, namely Rajesh Bhargav in conspiracy with Arvind Shrivastava, lodged a report against petitioner No.1 Smt. Neelu Kushwah and her husband herein petitioner no.2 Rajeev Singh Kushwah that in the night they came to his office for notarizing the documents and took away mobile of Arvind Kushwah and fled away from there.
When the wife of complainant tried to take the mobile from petitioner no.1 Smt. Neelu Kushwah, then her husband petitioner no.2 pushed and fled away from the place of occurrence by motorcycle.

On his report,
Crime No.580 of 2019 for commission of offence under Sections 323, 294, 506, 34 of IPC was registered against the petitioners.

The matter was investigated and after collecting documents and materials, police filed charge sheet against the present petitioners before the Court of JMFC on 07-0-2-2020 wherein the petitioners have been made accused for commission of offence under Sections 379 and 382 of IPC.
Hence, this petition.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that a false FIR has been lodged against the petitioners on account of previous dispute between the parties with a mala fide intention.
The petitioners in this regard have already submitted complaint to the police authorities but no action has been taken by the police authorities.

It is further submitted that on the same day when a report was lodged by petitioner no.1 Smt. Neelu Kushwah against Arvind Shrivastava and two unknown persons stating therein that the mobile of Arvind Kushwah was dropped on the place of incident and the same was handed over to the police.
In this situation, the FIR lodged by Rajesh Bhargav vide Crime No. 581 of 2019 for allegation of theft of same mobile under Sections 379 and 382 of IPC is wholly unreliable and cannot be relied upon.

It is further submitted that the charges have been framed against Arvind Shrivastava for commission of kidnapping and rape and the matter has been fixed for examination as well as cross-examination of prosecutrix.
The impugned FIR has been lodged against petitioners in order to pressurize them to make compromise in rape matter.
It is further contended that the without going the factural scenario of the matter, the police authorities have filed charge sheet erroneously for commission of aforesaid offence.
Therefore, a false lodging of FIR and subsequent filing of charge sheet is an abuse of process of law.
Prima facie, no offence under Sections 379 and 382 of IPC is made out against petitioners and they have falsely been implicated in the matter.

To buttress his contentions, learned counsel for the petitioners has relied on the judgments of Hon'ble Supreme Court in the cases of Uma Shankar Gopalika vs. State of Bihar and Another (2005) 10 SCC 336, Mahindra and Mahindra Financial Services Limitted and Another vs. Rajiv Dubey (2009) 1 SCC 706 and Dhariwal Tobacco Products Limited and Others vs. State of Maharashtra and Another, (2009) 2 SCC 370.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State as well as counsel for the complainant opposed the contentions of petitioners and submits that there is specific allegation against petitioners and after collecting materials and documents, police has rightly filed charge sheet against them.

Hence,
prayed for dismissal of this petition.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

On perusal of impugned FIRs as well as documents available on record, it appears that the criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioners is manifestly attended with mala fide and/or the proceedings are maliciously instituted with an ulterior motive for wrecking vengeance on the petitioners and with a view to spite them due to previous dispute.

Therefore, in view of ration laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the above-cited cases, this Court is of considered opinion that the impugned FIR does not disclose any offence whatsoever and prosecution is liable to be quashed.
It would be just and expedient to quash prosecution launched against aforesaid petitioners.
Accordingly, this petition is allowed.

The charge sheet as well as criminal proceedings pending before the Court of JMFC, Aron, District Guna in Criminal Case No.108 of 2020 arising out of FIR vide Crime No.581 of 2019 registered at Police Station Aron, District Guna for offence punishable under Sections 379 and 382 of IPC is hereby quashed and petitioners are discharged from aforesaid offence.
A copy of this order be sent to concerned Police Station and court concerned for information and compliance.
